label: Executive Power

notes.note: T2: overlay checked; one leg as drawn, spur and open corner kept

corrections.what: Kept one desk leg, at the left end, not the two the catalogue text names
corrections.why: The image controls. Both sheets show a single leg at x 19.3; the desk's right end disappears behind the upright order.

corrections.what: Made the head a true circle, centre (96.27, 23.8), r 13.19
Stood the left shoulder side upright at x 66.06 and drew the shoulder top as one line, y 44.78, between two true corner arcs (r 16.46 left, r 14.64 right)
corrections.why: DR-03 straight lines. The left side leans 4.5 deg on the sheet (x 65.6 to 66.5 over 12 px); the top measures y 44.67 to 44.9.

corrections.what: Drew the necktie as one filled shape symmetric about x 96.3: rounded knot, narrow neck, straight flaring blade and a rounded point
corrections.why: DR-03 symmetry. The red sheet's tie is centred at 96.3 to 96.4 on every row. The black sheet's tie runs about 0.4 px wider per side than the red sheet's; the trace sits between them.

corrections.what: Drew the signature as a four-segment zigzag polyline at W: up stroke, down stroke, short rise, flat tail
corrections.why: The sheet's squiggle is a blob about 7 px thick at its peak; the trace keeps its turning points from the red-sheet centreline and both sheets' outline.

corrections.what: Gave the order's three closed corners and the desk's left end a 2 px centreline corner radius
corrections.why: The sheet's outer corners round at about 4.5 to 5 px, wider than a plain round join.

source_notes: Kept: the face-free head; the right shoulder curving down into the order's left edge, ending in the small rounded spur that both sheets show just right of that edge; the order's top edge stopping 7 px short of its left edge (open top-left corner); the desk's top line running up to the order's edge and its lower line stopping 4 px short of it, so the order reads in front of the desk; the flat paper on the desk with the body's left side landing on its top edge; two equal rules on the order. Red: the tie and the signature, two separate accents, as on the red sheet.
